description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Puttalam, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam  District - Cad. Map No.  41011and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land in Puttalam district, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, and other property-related details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
